notes:
What's new since 2.0.1:
- New MetroBox logo in the app and the interface
- Update checker: MetroBox notifies you at launch when a new version is out, with release notes
- Liquid Glass Mode: frosted, translucent glass surfaces for light and dark themes (Settings > Theme)
- Faster playback start in VLC: resume works like the HyperOS updater should — about 3x faster
- Streams are prefetched when you open a show, so pressing Play starts instantly
- Built-in player hands HEVC streams to VLC/mpv instantly instead of showing black video
